checks.title: Goal Owner
checks.instructions: Agree on the customer outcome and source, decision and action owners. Produce an accepted offer decision and an unpublished seller-ready brief with exact claim and price evidence.

checks.title: Subject Scope
checks.instructions: Bind exact tenant and subject IDs. One offer, plan, price revision and buyer persona with protected customer contracts and a named pricing and enablement owner.

checks.title: Source Policy
checks.instructions: Agree on data access, version and source-of-truth policy. Read current billing price and entitlement revisions, unit-cost evidence, approved product claims and dated buyer objections.

checks.title: Decision Rule
checks.instructions: Record the blocking decision rule and evidence gaps. Pricing owner accepts the exact offer; Enablement removes stale prices and unsupported claims before a separate content review.

checks.title: Team Bindings
checks.instructions: Inspect the named Crew templates and existing compatible Crews. Record exact Crew IDs, skill versions and grants; propose creation only for a missing owner or access boundary.

checks.title: Source Access
checks.instructions: Read at least one real authorized first-stage record and the current downstream source. Record source IDs, observed times, permissions, missing fields and owner.

checks.title: Handoff Contract
checks.instructions: Run scripts/validate_handoff.py on each stage artifact. Block wrong tenant, subject, source revision, producer, approval or route-specific claim. The typed sequence is gtm-offer-decision/v1 → gtm-enablement-brief/v1.

checks.title: Plan Review
checks.instructions: Show the concrete Crew bindings, artifact paths, validator steps, manual route, approvals, deduplication, cost and notifications. No billing price, entitlement, contract, public page, seller asset or prospect contact changes from this proposal.

checks.title: Test Run
checks.instructions: Reconcile a real plan against billing and entitlement sources, reject one stale claim, then review the unpublished seller asset. Save real source references, artifacts, validation and owner corrections. Fictional examples cannot complete this check.

checks.title: Activation Choice
checks.instructions: Manual-only is valid. Any event or schedule needs exact subject and deduplication keys, permissions, retry limits, cost and notification review. Keep all consequential actions behind separate approval and provider receipts.
